label: Food and Beverage Manager
summary: Two Food and Beverages Resumes against Health and Fitness and Aviation.
job_description:
Sonesta Hotels is hiring a Food and Beverage Manager to run restaurant and banquet service for a full-service property, owning cost, staffing and guest experience.

What we need:
- Ability to work nights, weekends, holidays
- Staff Training
- Event Planning

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Valid ServSafe Manager certification; Valid Louisiana Responsible Vendors License; Previous hotel, restaurant and bar experience; Leadership; Revenue Forecasting; Inventory Management; POS Systems; Microsoft Office; Problem Solving.
